result.document_summary: A San Francisco Rent Board news notice announcing the 1.6% annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units for 3/1/2026 through 2/28/2027.
result.notes: The page names no underlying ordinance, so the citation is the page title. It does not describe which buildings are rent-controlled, so coverage is expressed only as the 'rent-controlled units' condition. The prior-year 1.4% allowance is mentioned only as background and is not extracted as a separate rule.

rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase (3/1/2026 - 2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent.
rules.citation: Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27 Announced, SF Rent Board (sf.gov)
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco; the page does not define which buildings are rent-controlled.
